title: A Chinese AI Just Dethroned Claude Fable 5 🤯
description:
The AI leaderboard has a new champion.

**Kimi K3** just jumped from **#18 to #1** in a single release, overtaking Claude Fable 5 on coding benchmarks.

What makes this release so significant?

✅ Ranked #1 across 6 of 7 frontend coding domains
✅ 2.8 trillion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model
✅ 1 million token context window
✅ Native multimodal (vision) capabilities
✅ Built for long-horizon coding and complex reasoning
✅ Fully open source

Perhaps the most impressive part is that the **full model weights are scheduled to be released on July 27**, making one of the world's most capable coding models available to everyone.

Whether you're a developer, AI enthusiast, or founder, Kimi K3 is one model worth watching.

Subscribe for more AI news, open-source releases, and developer tools.
